scope: Independent visual review of seven recovered native outputs and two native corrections produced by other agents.
method: Viewed the named native PNGs and the named source images. Read-only alpha probes checked suspicious background RGB. No image alteration or registry change.
independence: All nine native outputs in this review were produced by other agents. The reviewer generated the two Ascension outputs, so those are excluded from this independent source-image section.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Three exterior hands/arms, two feet; the third hand rests against the thigh and its attachment is partially occluded.
entries.observation: One complete bent figure, long black hair and lowered knife. The profile points right and retains the unusual three-arm topology.
limitations: The hidden third-arm attachment, torso twist and face projection remain interpreted.
No concealed anatomy or source animation is certified.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Two long forearms/hands, two folded hind limbs with overlap, one cranial filament fan.
entries.observation: Complete right-facing crouch matches the plain-body source phase. No extended tongue or floral-overgrown phase is mixed in.
limitations: Palm-mouth details are not assessable with the hands turned down.
The crouched envelope does not establish a canonical standing-equivalent height.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Two arms/hands and two legs/feet, with the far-side limbs partly overlapping.
entries.observation: Whole gaunt profile faces right. Cavernous head, collar/lock, hip wrapping, shackles, branches and chain ends preserve source identity.
limitations: Far-side anatomy, surface marks and exact chain lengths are reconstructed.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Two colored arms, two complete tapered blade legs; no extra human feet.
entries.observation: One complete right-facing ceramic doll, mask, white hair/twigs, ball joints and curved knife. The intact phase is kept separate from the disassembly sheet.
limitations: Exact joint construction and blade/knife curvature remain interpreted.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Two asymmetric weapon arms and two small complete feet.
entries.observation: Whole right-facing barrel-shaped figure. Top membranes, tomoe mouth drum, flowers/roots, rope/bells, spiked arm and twisted bachi arm are retained.
limitations: The side projection and concealed drum surfaces are inferred from front/back art.
The mouth-drum plane is oblique for legibility; strict orthographic equivalence is not certified.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Two hands; feet remain concealed by the source-style floor-length garment.
entries.observation: Complete right-facing base wedding form with tall wataboshi, patterned mask, tassel and full sleeves/train. No enlarged claw-arm phase is mixed in.
limitations: Hidden legs and exact mask/garment folds are not established by this reconstruction.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Three thick tubular appendages and three open mouth rims connected to one small root-like base; no walking limbs.
entries.observation: One complete environmental entity. All three mouths point right; the common base and each extremity remain inside the image.
limitations: The lateral arrangement is authored from an oblique source.
This review accepts an atelier/reference candidate only; combat remains disabled.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Exactly two small lower feet/supports and two asymmetric arms: one knife hand and one curled tubular end.
entries.observation: No extra third foot is visible after correction. Whole floral crown, knife tip, tubular arm and feet remain in the canvas. The face and body read toward the right.
limitations: The nose/mouth projection remains more regular than the irregular source mass.
The head and torso retain some oblique presentation; this is a candidate, not a strict orthographic or one-to-one certification.
Fine floral arrangement and hidden anatomy remain interpreted.

entries.visibleAnatomy: Exactly eight visible hands (four behind/left and four ahead/right), and two feet. No ninth hand is visible.
entries.observation: One complete right-facing figure with white hair, lead red mask and surrounding masks, crescent-patterned black robe, segmented arms, rope belt and hanging roots.
limitations: Hidden arm attachments, exact mask arrangement and garment folds remain interpreted.
Some chest presentation is oblique for arm readability. Phase-specific weapons/animations are not represented.

alphaDiagnostic.observation: Brown/gray preview RGB alone is not an opaque-background defect. Read-only native samples away from the figure have alpha zero.

limits: Candidate acceptance is distinct from source fidelity, combat balance and complete animation coverage.
Exact source scale, concealed geometry, source timing and one-to-one fidelity remain unverified.
Tight native padding on several outputs is recorded in delivery metadata; no readable extremity was found cropped in this visual review.
